rows.en: You too, Sharivan?
My mission is to rebuild Planet Iga! That's why I'm fighting Madou.
Oh my…
That's right… We're people of the same planet! To think I'd find comrades even at the far end of the galaxy…
We've met quite a few people from Planet Iga…

I see… We have to call everyone together!

We'll gather the people scattered across the galaxy and rebuild Planet Iga!
Yes!
Cough, cough… ugh…
Billy, Billy!!
He's burning up! We have to cool him down, quickly…
I'll go get some water!
Madou might be around! Be careful!

Found you!

You people of Iga are rebels who defy our Madou! I'll wipe you out, without fail!
I won't let you!
I want the Demon Crystal… I want to obtain the invincible Demon Crystal and seize the wealth and power of the entire universe!
Doubleman!!
Sir…
This is serious! It seems Makuu and Fuuma are after the legendary Demon Crystal…
The legendary Demon Crystal?
But… why would the Demon Crystal of Planet Bird's legends be on Earth, Papa?

Hmm…

5000 years ago… Planet Bird was locked in endless war. Because of the golden Demon Crystal!

Even the most timid man became invincible when he wore the Demon Crystal. So bloody battles were always being fought over it…

The people realized that as long as the Demon Crystal existed, the wars would never end. So they carried the Demon Crystal to Earth, at the far end of the galaxy, and buried it there!

Ever since, Planet Bird has been a planet of peace and intellect…
I see… Makuu is after that Demon Crystal!
If the Demon Crystal falls into Makuu's hands, the whole universe will…
All right…
To create an invincible Fushigi Beast, the Demon Crystal is absolutely essential! Seize it! The Demon Crystal…
Leave it to me! I shall obtain it without fail…
Shoketsu!!
Is that the Bell siblings' space boat?

The model is Gamma QR3…

It matches the information from the command satellite! Most likely it's the Bell siblings'…
Is that the Bell siblings' space boat?

It says Gamma QR3…

Same as what Annie said, right? It's probably the Bell siblings' ship…
No doubt about it! Let's rescue the Bell siblings!!

Nngh… Someone's interfering!?

The Demon Crystal is deep inside that cave! Hmph…
Wait! Running away isn't like you, Doubleman!
The entire universe is made up of the Heavenly World, the Earthly World and the Fushigi World.
Helen! Damn it, Sekisha!
Genmu World generator, activate!!
Wait, Space Sheriffs! Look at this!

…!?

Billy!!

…!?

Billy!!
Hahaha… I'll execute this one!
Die!
Nuoooh! Who's that? Who's interfering?

Space Sheriff Gavan!!

Makuu! Using such dirty tricks! I won't let you have the Demon Crystal!
Hahaha… It's too late! With this, I'm invincible!
Damn… He got the Demon Crystal?
No enemy can match the Demon Crystal!!
Create Makuu Space. Get in Gavan's way!
Nngh… Those Space Sheriffs again! You'll pay for this!
Nuooh… The Demon Crystal was supposed to be invincible!? Whyyy!

They said whoever obtained this Demon Crystal could never be defeated… So why?

I see!? 5000 long years must have drained its magic power!

They said whoever obtained this Demon Crystal could never be defeated… So why?

I see!? 5000 long years must have drained its magic power!
How is he?
Billy…
Hang in there, Billy! That's what you get for being reckless…
I wanted to help you, big bro…
Big bro?
We're from the same planet, right? So you're like a big brother. My big brother…
Billy…
I'm glad I met you… glad I got to meet you, big bro.
You're coming to Planet Iga, aren't you? Let's rebuild it together!
I'll go… I will, for sure!
Billy… You're giving your charm to Sharivan?
Take me with you, okay… me too…
Yeah, I'll take you… I'll take you there, I promise!!
Big bro, look after sis…
Billy, Billyyy!
Billyyy, Billyyy!
Den…
I wanted to take him there… to Planet Iga.

Billy was happy…

He always used to say it. "I want a big brother, I want a big brother!" Coming to Earth was really a good thing.
Please don't push yourself any further! Billy asked me to look after you…
I'll fight… against Madou!
Helen! Let's fight together!!

But… with my strength as it is now, I'm no match for Madou! I need to train, more and more…

so I won't drag you down, Sharivan…
Helen…
Helen!!
